SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-15-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-15-2016 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF KURT OESTERREICHER AND DEFENDANT'S REPRESENTATIVE JOHN WILSON, PRESIDENT OF CALIFORNIA CARPET, LLC. PARTIES SIGNED THE STIPULATION FOR PRO TEM JUDGE. NO PROOF OF SERVICE, BUT DEFENDANT'S REPRESENTATIVE WAIVED SERVICE OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AT TODAY'S HEARING. DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-15-2016 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF OESTERREICHER, KURT IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT CALIFORNIA CARPET, LLC. DBA CALIFORNIA CARPET & RUGS IN LIGHT OF WHAT APPEARS TO BE PARTIAL CREDIT CARD CREDIT TO PLAINTIFF, THE COURT FINDS THAT PLAINTIFF HAS NOT ESTABLISHED ANY DAMAGES BASED ON DEFENDANT'S ALLEGEDLY DEFICIENT CARPET INSTALLATION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
